summary: First-finish smoke test of Indian Rounds Travel CRM. Verified auth (3 roles), role-based route/sidebar guarding, auto lead-ID generation (IR07001/IR07002), lead creation via API + UI, dashboard KPIs & charts, and role restrictions. All critical flows functional.
passed: POST /api/auth/login works for admin, sales, ops (all 3 seeded users authenticate, JWT returned)
GET /api/dashboard/stats returns KPIs (total_leads, today_leads, monthly, top_destinations, status_counts)
GET /api/master returns seeded master data (destinations Bali, Dubai, Maldives visible)
POST /api/leads creates lead with auto ID IR07002 (format IR<MM><nnn>, running increment confirmed - IR07001 pre-existing, next was IR07002)
GET /api/leads returns leads (sales sees own leads only - Aarav Test visible for sales)
GET /api/users returns 200 for admin, 403 for sales (RBAC enforced at API)
Login page loads, admin login lands on dashboard with all 7 nav items (dashboard/leads/users/master/activity/suppliers/ai) + KPIs + charts render
Sales user dashboard: sidebar restricted to Dashboard/My Leads/New Lead/AI Assistant only. No users/master/activity/suppliers visible. 'Welcome back, Ravi Kumar' confirms correct staff.
Ops user dashboard: sidebar shows Dashboard/All Leads/Suppliers/AI Assistant. No users/master/activity/new-lead visible. Correct RBAC.
Sales user direct navigation to /users redirects away (route guard working)
Ops user direct navigation to /users redirects away

Ops opens lead detail: sees Supplier Mail button, AI Itinerary, AI Quote, editable Supplier Quote/Selling with auto-computed Profit, pipeline status dropdown, supplier mail history panel. Lead ID IR07002 rendered correctly with 'New Lead' status badge.
Logout clears session and redirects to /login
CORS: frontend at preview URL successfully calls backend /api routes via cookies + Bearer token

failed.issue: 'Made with Emergent' badge (id=emergent-badge) intercepts pointer events over the 'Create Lead' submit button on /leads/new form. Standard clicks are blocked; only force=true clicks succeed. Real users hitting the bottom-right area may struggle to submit if the button is under the badge.
failed.evidence: Playwright: '<a id="emergent-badge"> intercepts pointer events' — 20 retry attempts on data-testid=submit-lead. Screenshot shows badge overlaying bottom-right of form area.

failed.issue: Lead 'budget' field is a string (Pydantic rejects int). Fine per model, but frontend/API consumers should be aware. Not a bug, informational.
failed.evidence: POST /api/leads with budget:50000 returns 422 'Input should be a valid string'; budget:"50000" succeeds.

failed.issue: Recharts warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' spam console during initial render. Charts eventually render correctly (verified visually). Non-blocking.
failed.evidence: 18+ console warnings from Recharts ResponsiveContainer on dashboard mount.

not_tested: Full Supplier Mail send dialog flow (mocked) - checkbox + send + mail_status update
AI Itinerary + AI Quote actual LLM invocation (Claude)
action_items: MEDIUM: Investigate z-index / positioning of the 'Create Lead' submit button vs the Emergent badge on /leads/new. Ensure primary action buttons are not covered by the fixed badge (consider bottom padding on form container or repositioning submit).
LOW: Consider accepting numeric budget in Pydantic model or documenting the string requirement.
LOW: Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer parent width warnings on dashboard (add explicit height/min-height to chart containers).
